rationale: Despite gapping up on positive earnings news, QMCO has completely faded its opening gains to trade below yesterday's close, session VWAP, and its 5-minute 9-EMA. However, at 12:10 ET, 1-minute volume has dried up to just a few thousand shares per bar and the bid-ask spread is very wide at 78.9 bps ($0.13), making execution costs prohibitive relative to the $0.32 5-minute ATR. With the price already extended near the bottom of its daily range (8.8%), neither chasing the downside nor catching a falling knife offers a favorable risk-to-reward profile.
